runs.prompt: Add a method Has to Cart in cart/cart.go that reports whether a SKU is in the cart, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:

runs.prompt: Add a method Holds to Stock in inventory/inventory.go that returns the number of reservations that have not expired, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Stock.Holds()` in [inventory.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.3/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory.go). It counts reservations whose expiry time has not been reached. [TestHolds](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.3/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory_test.go) covers active holds, the exact expiry boundary, release, and confirmation.

runs.prompt: Add a method Accounts to Sessions in accounts/session.go that returns the number of registered accounts, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Sessions.Accounts()` in [session.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.3/run-04/repo/accounts/session.go). It returns the registered account count under the existing lock. [TestAccounts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.3/run-04/repo/accounts/session_test.go) covers an empty store, two registrations, and a duplicate registration.
